name: agent
description: The local runtime and website for Agent.

scripts.build: node --input-type=module --eval "import { rmSync } from 'node:fs'; rmSync('dist', { recursive: true, force: true })" && tsc -p tsconfig.json && node --input-type=module --eval "import { cpSync } from 'node:fs'; cpSync('src/web', 'dist/web', { recursive: true })" && node --input-type=module --eval "import { chmodSync } from 'node:fs'; chmodSync('dist/bin/agent.js', 0o755)"
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run build
